It is clearly observable and verifiable — the agent must navigate to and look at the block. It doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, making it accessible. As a single task, the dependency graph is trivial with one node and no edges.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the light_gray_terracotta fountain feature (centered at spawn-relative [8, 0, -4]) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the target.' The terracotta is ~10 blocks from spawn requiring intentional navigation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the terracotta rather than facing away.

scene_description: A small village scene with multiple structures: an oak planks building to the southeast, a cobblestone shelter to the northwest, a cow on a wooden platform to the south, and a decorative light_gray_terracotta fountain/border feature to the east-northeast. The player must navigate the scene to find the light_gray_terracotta blocks which form a distinctive border around a water feature with oak fence posts.
task_text: Find the light_gray_terracotta blocks in the scene. Navigate around the area and locate the distinctive pale gray terracotta blocks.
design_notes: The light_gray_terracotta blocks are placed at ~7-9, ~0, ~-3 to ~-5 forming a decorative border around a water block. They are about 10 blocks from spawn to the east-northeast, requiring the agent to turn and navigate. The scene includes distractors (cobblestone building, oak building, cow platform) to make exploration non-trivial. The terracotta has a distinct pinkish-tan color that contrasts with the green grass, making it identifiable once the agent looks in the right direction. Exactly 8 terracotta blocks are placed: 3 at z=-5 (x=7,8,9), 3 at z=-3 (x=7,8,9), 1 at x=7/z=-4, and 1 at x=9/z=-4.
